description:
Overview

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você. Em Impostos , estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros. #TaxEY
Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida em Campinas. #hybrid

Como Gerente Tributário/a Sênior, você ajudará nossos clientes a identificar áreas de riscos, oportunidades de planejamento sustentável ao longo do ciclo de vida dos impostos indiretos e apoiar no cumprimento de obrigações de conformidade e metas de negócios em todo o mundo.

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

  • Liderar e participar de vários projetos de consultoria na área de VAT, oferecendo assistência na identificação de áreas de risco e oportunidades de planejamento sustentável em tributos em todas as etapas de incidência de impostos, ajudando os clientes a cumprir suas obrigações de compliance e seus objetivos de negócios;
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos produtivos com o cliente ao longo do ano. Estabelecer expectativas de valor a ser produzido como resultado;
  • Manter-se informado/a sobre os desenvolvimentos econômicos e corporativos gerais e seu impacto para o cliente;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, incentivando-as a refletir e a assumir responsabilidade por suas contribuições à equipe. Delegar trabalho de forma bem-sucedida, conduzindo revisões de desempenho de forma tempestiva e fornecer feedback/treinamento com relação ao desempenho apresentado;
  • Ter um entendimento das linhas de serviço da EY e buscar/incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços da empresa;
  • Manter relacionamentos de cooperação com outras equipes de trabalho. Monitorar o progresso da equipe de trabalho com relação ao planejamento e fazer alterações quando necessário.
  • Gerar novas oportunidades de negócio. Ter um bom entendimento sobre a EY e suas linhas de serviço e avaliar/apresentar de forma ativa maneiras para a aplicação do conhecimento e dos serviços da empresa. Desenvolver relacionamentos duradouros tanto dentro como fora da empresa.

Por que você?

  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS e ISS);
  • Habilidades de gestão de projetos;

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Experiência em projetos de compliance e/ou planejamento, análise e revisão de procedimentos fiscais, levantamento de créditos tributários, elaboração de relatórios e consultas sobre questões tributárias e fiscais e reestruturação de operações;
  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, Compliance e Planejamento Tributário;
  • Expertise em elaboração de propostas técnicas e desenvolvimento de novos negócios;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.

O que oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work 2022, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

title: Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.

Additional Information

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits:

  • 100% remote-friendly within Brazil
  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;
  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options- eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period)
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

Faça parte do CNPEM!

No Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM), somos movidos pela paixão pela ciência. Nosso ambiente é um vibrante centro de pesquisa e desenvolvimento, onde profissionais de diversas especialidades se conectam para enfrentar desafios complexos e criar soluções para problemas relevantes, especialmente nas áreas de saúde, energia, materiais renováveis e sustentabilidade.

Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente, desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional.

Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT).

Todo esse ecossistema é sustentado por uma rede integrada de áreas estratégicas que inclui tecnologia da informação, comunicação, gestão de projetos, assessoria jurídica & compliance, recursos humanos, finanças, compras, sustentabilidade e inovação, alocadas entre Diretoria Geral (DG) e Diretoria de Serviços Compartilhados (DSC). A Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI) assegura a manutenção das instalações, o suporte à engenharia e o desenvolvimento arquitetônico, criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades.

A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro.

Acreditamos que o sucesso é alcançado por meio de dedicação, colaboração e propósito claro. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos profissionais e estudantes, oferecendo um ambiente inspirador e favorável para o crescimento profissional e pessoal.

Estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e buscamos soluções que promovam um futuro mais verde. Prezamos pelo cuidado e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, ao mesmo tempo em que valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas.

Se você é apaixonado por ciência e busca um lugar onde você possa fazer a diferença, junte-se a nós no CNPEM.

title: Client Manager
description:
Overview

Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. We are reimagining what’s possible in our industry with a configurable, AI-powered platform and expert support. This role is full remote, located in California, and part of the Customer Success Team as a Client Manager focusing on client interactions, processes, and improving client success within our payment integrity platform.

The ideal hire will ensure timely issue resolution and take action on anticipated client needs to deliver value, collaborating with operational and technical teams to optimize success and deliver the best value to our clients through strong support strategies.

What you’ll do

  • Ensure the Machinify team delivers value to clients through efficient operational processes, enhanced reporting, comprehensive user training, and exceptional support strategies
  • Help create and drive execution on client strategy including intentional relationship building and supporting growth expansion initiatives
  • Identify actionable insights from healthcare claims data and results
  • Project financial results and company revenue based on KPI data and business dynamics
  • Review all client-facing reporting for accuracy, including reporting that covers: impacts of policy customizations or modifications; comparing actual results to expectations; trends by product, line of business, policy, providers, etc.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the assigned client’s organizational structure, business objectives, and opportunities, translating that into a value proposition Machinify can deliver against
  • Generate materials and reporting to deliver insights to the customer and demonstrate program performance against key success metrics
  • Document and provide organizational visibility to key internal stakeholders on insights, risks, and client activities and expectations; track progress of initiatives
  • Work with leadership to communicate actionable findings to support client understanding of the data
  • Become an expert on company platform(s) to support client workflow, delivery, and user onboarding and training
  • Introduce new functionality and capabilities and obtain product feedback for the Product team
  • Support client contracting efforts and SLA management
  • Monitor solution performance and deliver quantifiable and qualitative insights to customers via regular meetings and reviews
  • Act as a key contact for client inquiries, support, and all key deliverables
  • Occasional travel requirements up to 25% of the year to meet client needs

Role Requirements

  • 5-7 years in client-facing roles (client management, customer success, or similar)
  • Proven track record for cultivating and influencing relationships within the healthcare payer market
  • Previous experience in the healthcare Payment Integrity space highly preferred
  • Analytical strength to observe, understand questions, and explain answers in healthcare claims data
  • Excellent communication skills, adept at presenting materials and speaking on topics extemporaneously
  • Ability to work with a range of individuals and manage multiple requests with fast turnaround
  • Driven self-starter mindset, eager to collaborate in a cross-functional environment
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate autonomously
  • High attention to detail and process orientation
  • Holds a high level of integrity

What Success Looks Like…

After 3 months

  • You will have a strong understanding of the role
  • You will begin building relationships and collaborating with peers
  • You will develop effective time and priorities management
  • You will receive initial feedback and use it to improve
  • You will gain confidence and feel more comfortable in your role

After 1 year

  • You have mastered the tasks and responsibilities of the position with confidence and efficiency
  • You have established a strong network of internal relationships and are recognized as a key collaborator
  • You’ve been entrusted with greater responsibility indicating company confidence in your abilities
  • You see opportunities for career progression and personal development

Pay range : $130,000-$175,000 USD; role is eligible for Annual Performance Bonus

This is an exempt position. The salary range is for Base Salary. Compensation will be determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, skill set, years of experience, and geographic location.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexible Time Off (FTO)
  • Eligibility for health, vision, and dental coverage, 401(k) with company match, and flexible spending accounts
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Eligibility for company-paid benefits including life insurance, short-term disability, and parental leave
  • Remote and hybrid work options

What values we’ll share with you

  • Ask why
  • Think big
  • Be humble
  • Optimize for customer impact
  • Deliver results

At Machinify, we’re reimagining a simpler way forward. We are innovators who value integrity, teamwork, accuracy, and flexibility. We do the right thing and listen to client needs. We champion diverse perspectives to better serve our clients.

Our values come to life through our culture. We embrace flexible work arrangements and cross-functional collaboration. We invest in ongoing education and team celebrations, and we give back through volunteering. Machinify is dedicated to making healthcare work better for everyone.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Machinify is an employment-at-will employer. We participate in E-Verify as required by law. We do not inquire about salary history during recruitment. title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we\'re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title

Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location

Remote

Employment Type

Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

Role and Responsibilities

  • We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master\'s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.
  • This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology.
  • Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

title: Director, Duals Experience
description:
Overview

You could be the one who changes everything for our 28 million members. Centene is transforming the health of our communities, one person at a time. As a diversified, national organization, you’ll have access to competitive benefits including a fresh perspective on workplace flexibility.

This is a fully remote role. Candidates may reside anywhere within the continental U.S. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with Medicare and Medicaid operations, with Duals program experience highly preferred.

Position Purpose

This role is responsible for identifying opportunities and guiding strategies to improve the overall member experience for Duals members. The position focuses on developing and implementing member satisfaction and retention strategies across all product lines through cross-functional collaboration at a senior leadership level. Key departments involved include, but are not limited to, Member Services, Grievances and Appeals, Quality, Provider Relations, Network Operations and Contracting, Health Equity, Vendor Management, Product, Finance, Enrollment, IT, Communications, Sales, and Marketing. Analyzing and interpreting member needs to develop both short- and long-term strategic directives and programs aimed at enhancing the member experience is an expectation of the role. The position provides strategic and operational insights to senior leadership to drive key initiatives and market growth plans, while ensuring alignment with broader organizational initiatives through collaboration with Corporate Strategy partners. Additionally, the role acts as a key resource for gathering information and initiating action plans on a wide range of topics, issues, and projects that impact operations and strategic initiatives.

  • Analysis of outcome data, adjusting strategy accordingly and pro-actively to maximize outcomes for experience driven measures.
  • Provides strategic oversight and leadership for all member experience activities for Dual members and providers.
  • Partners with Quality to support Quality and Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) initiatives and focus on STARS improvement, CAHPS, access and availability surveys, financial incentives and improving EPSDT scores.

Education/Experience

  • 5+ years of supervisory/management experience.
  • 7+ years of Strategic Planning or Business Development or similar experience. Preferred: Background in consumer experience. BA/BS - Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent required. MS - in a Health Care related field preferred.

Pay Range: $116,100.00 - $214,700.00 per year

Benefits

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act

description:
Overview

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users\' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Responsibilities

  • Managing Google Ads Campaigns: Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Search, Display, and Video.
  • Bottom-of-Funnel Focus: Prioritize conversions that go beyond lead generation, including SQLs, pipeline impact, and closed-won revenue.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams: Partner closely with sales to align on lead quality, refine campaign targeting, and maintain a strong feedback loop.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Create dashboards and evaluate campaign results using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and spreadsheets.
  • Full-Funnel & Lead Quality Insights: Deep knowledge of the buyer journey and how paid media influences progression through the funnel.
  • A/B Testing & Creative Iteration: Conduct A/B tests on targeting, ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding tactics to drive performance gains.
  • Cross-Channel Integration: Collaborate with the broader marketing team to maintain cohesive messaging and strategic alignment across all channels.
  • Landing Page & CRO Collaboration: Coordinate with design teams to enhance landing page effectiveness and improve conversion rates.
  • Budget Management & Forecasting: Manage spend pacing and performance targets, with clear reporting on ROI and CAC.
  • Platform Expansion: Research and experiment with emerging ad formats and placements within the Google Ads platform.

Experience we\'re looking for

  • Expertise in Google Ads: Over 5 years of hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across Google Search, Display, and Video.
  • Full-Funnel Focus: Skilled in tracking and optimizing campaigns beyond top-of-funnel leads, with an emphasis on driving revenue.
  • Strong Analytical Abilities: Proficiency in using Google Analytics, spreadsheets, Looker Studio (or similar tools), and analyzing campaign performance data.
  • Collaboration with Sales: Proven experience partnering with sales teams to enhance campaign impact on the sales pipeline.
  • Advanced Conversion Tracking: Knowledgeable in UTM parameters, pixel setup, and using Google Tag Manager for tracking.
  • Proficient in English: Effective in communicating and collaborating in English across teams and documentation.
  • CRM Awareness: Understanding of how paid media campaigns connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

What we’re looking for this role to achieve

  • Drive higher revenue attributed to marketing through Google Ads campaigns.
  • Enhance SQL rates and boost lead-to-deal conversions via paid media channels.
  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.
  • Lower cost per acquisition (CPA) while improving return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Expand a full-funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

  • In collaboration with delivery leads, identify initial pipeline targets and key client relationships.

  • Actively lead at least five pursuits across your assigned region.
  • Develop win strategies and lead opportunity shaping efforts.
  • Attend relevant conferences, industry events, and client briefings.
  • Review competitive proposals.
  • Identify and negotiate teaming relationships with local partners or primes.
  • Actively engage with key ICF stakeholders across all four EEI lines of business.

12–18 Month Expectations

  • Close new business totaling $20M+ in contract value.
  • Contribute to statewide or regional growth strategy planning efforts.
  • Co-develop state-specific marketing campaigns with support from ICF’s marketing team.
  • Develop value propositions and pursuit playbooks for recurring opportunity types.
  • Champion cross-ICF collaboration and alignment between technical and BD teams.
  • Maintain accurate CRM updates, forecasts, and pursuit documentation.

Preferred skills

  • Background in one or more of the following sectors: climate adaptation, disaster recovery, infrastructure, transportation, energy efficiency, or environmental consulting.
  • Track record of leading and winning pursuits of $10M+ in total contract value.
  • Demonstrated understanding of government funding and procurement cycles at the state and local level.
  • Experience working with or for a state agency, city government, or county government.

  • Familiarity with CRM and pipeline tools (e.g., Dynamics, Salesforce).

title: IT and Information Security Coordinator
description:
Our Company

Tenchi is a Cyber Security company building innovative technology focused on Third-Party Cyber Risk Management for businesses. Founded by serial entrepreneurs and supported by solid institutional investors, we are driven to disrupt this fast-growing industry.

Tenchi was created to tackle a real challenge: companies often face security risks because their third-parties don’t maintain the same level of cyber protection. This gap leaves even the largest organizations potentially vulnerable to incidents they can’t directly control. That’s exactly where we step in.

Our TPCRM SaaS solution, Zanshin, is the only global TPCRM solution that offers both inside-out and outside-in visibility – combining external attack surface monitoring with automated, continuous, and non-intrusive assessments of cloud infrastructure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and security controls.

Our People and Culture

At Tenchi, we build innovative technology to help companies secure their ecosystems with transparency and peace of mind. We are ambitious and purpose-driven. Our culture is rooted in intentionality, transparency, and action. We move fast, communicate openly, and invest in people who want to make an impact.

As a 100% remote company with team members across Brazil, the US, Canada, Argentina, and Spain, we embrace flexibility while solving meaningful challenges together.

Want to know more about our DNA? Watch the video.

What you’ll do?

  • Provide technical support to internal users, identifying and resolving complex IT and security-related issues.
  • Manage and configure IT assets and ensure secure and compliant environments.
  • Oversee identity and access management, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, and enforcement of least privilege principles.
  • Administer and configure endpoint protection tools, antivirus, patch management systems, and Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions.
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of internal IT and security procedures and documentation.
  • Collaborate with the security and compliance teams in conducting risk assessments, internal audits, and implementing GRC controls aligned with privacy and other applicable legislation and the CIS Critical Security Controls framework
  • Ensure best practices are followed in day-to-day operations regarding systems, access, and incident response.
  • Keep up with industry trends and threats to advise on improvements and preventive measures.
  • Educate employees on security policies, awareness, and safe practices.
  • Administer AWS environments and apply best security practices, including provisioning access and permissions, implement security features, monitoring and investigating suspicious activities.
  • Collaborate with the engineering team to improve the security of CI/CD pipelines, assist in remediating vulnerabilities, and perform security reviews of changes involving Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Assist clients in implementing and maintaining SSO integrations.
  • Collaborate on strategic planning for the department in alignment with business needs, utilizing OKRs, roadmaps, business plans, and budget planning.

What we’re looking for?

  • Proven experience with Windows and Unix-like operating systems.
  • Strong background in providing technical support to end users.
  • Experience with access management processes, including provisioning and revoking access securely.
  • Strong background with Google Workspace and Slack administration from a security perspective.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing antivirus software, patch management systems, and MDM tools.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms, especially AWS, and how to secure workloads in these environments.
  • Understanding of information security best practices and security frameworks, in particular CIS Critical Security Controls and privacy legislation like LGPD and GDPR.
  • Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines, SAST/DAST tools, Git, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Knowledge of authentication protocols such as SAML, OpenID, and OAuth2, with hands-on experience configuring SSO integrations.
  • Comfortable writing clear procedures, internal policies, and emails/documentation in English.
  • Spoken Portuguese and English fluency is mandatory and will be used daily to interact with team members, partners and vendors in several countries.

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
Overview

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users\' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone\'s opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Responsibilities

  • Managing Google Ads Campaigns: Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Search, Display, and Video.
  • Bottom-of-Funnel Focus: Prioritize conversions that go beyond lead generation, including SQLs, pipeline impact, and closed-won revenue.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams: Partner closely with sales to align on lead quality, refine campaign targeting, and maintain a strong feedback loop.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Create dashboards and evaluate campaign results using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and spreadsheets.
  • Full-Funnel & Lead Quality Insights: Deep knowledge of the buyer journey and how paid media influences progression through the funnel.
  • A/B Testing & Creative Iteration: Conduct A/B tests on targeting, ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding tactics to drive performance gains.
  • Cross-Channel Integration: Collaborate with the broader marketing team to maintain cohesive messaging and strategic alignment across all channels.
  • Landing Page & CRO Collaboration: Coordinate with design teams to enhance landing page effectiveness and improve conversion rates.
  • Budget Management & Forecasting: Manage spend pacing and performance targets, with clear reporting on ROI and CAC.
  • Platform Expansion: Research and experiment with emerging ad formats and placements within the Google Ads platform.

Experience we\'re looking for

  • Expertise in Google Ads: Over 5 years of hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across Google Search, Display, and Video.
  • Full-Funnel Focus: Skilled in tracking and optimizing campaigns beyond top-of-funnel leads, with an emphasis on driving revenue.
  • Strong Analytical Abilities: Proficiency in using Google Analytics, spreadsheets, Looker Studio (or similar tools), and analyzing campaign performance data.
  • Collaboration with Sales: Proven experience partnering with sales teams to enhance campaign impact on the sales pipeline.
  • Advanced Conversion Tracking: Knowledgeable in UTM parameters, pixel setup, and using Google Tag Manager for tracking.
  • Proficient in English: Effective in communicating and collaborating in English across teams and documentation.
  • CRM Awareness: Understanding of how paid media campaigns connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

What we’re looking for this role to achieve

  • Drive higher revenue attributed to marketing through Google Ads campaigns.
  • Enhance SQL rates and boost lead-to-deal conversions via paid media channels.
  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.
  • Lower cost per acquisition (CPA) while improving return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Expand a full-funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

Na CPFL, você encontra um ambiente sólido para crescer com confiança, com segurança para evoluir e espaço para construir um futuro com propósito.

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial.

Empresa: CPFL Brasil – Uma empresa do Grupo CPFL Energia.

  • Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em direito ou economia;
  • Necessária experiência com regulação e comercialização, com foco em geração e mercado livre de energia;
  • Necessário conhecimento aprofundado acerca do arcabouço legal/regulatório do Setor Elétrico;
  • Diferencial conhecimento de estrutura tarifária;
  • Necessário inglês avançado (utilização no dia a dia para reuniões e elaboração de apresentações);
  • Disponibilidade para atuar 100% presencial em Campinas/SP.

O seu dia a dia:

  • Monitorar continuamente alterações legais, infralegais e regulatórias, analisando documentos de ANEEL, MME, CCEE, ONS, EPE e agências estaduais, para identificar riscos e oportunidades para os negócios.
  • Realizar análises técnicas dos impactos regulatórios sobre ativos e produtos, utilizando modelos e dados setoriais, com o objetivo de propor ajustes e mitigadores, além de identificar oportunidades, quando houver.
  • Elaborar e revisar contribuições técnicas para participações públicas, assegurando alinhamento institucional e profundidade técnica dos argumentos.
  • Colaborar com a elaboração de manifestações e recursos administrativos, junto a órgãos reguladores, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e a defesa dos interesses da empresa.
  • Analisar preços, encargos setoriais e projeções tarifárias, utilizando ferramentas analíticas para avaliar impactos no Ambiente de Contratação Livre (ACL).
  • Representar tecnicamente a empresa em fóruns, grupos de trabalho e associações setoriais, defendendo posicionamentos estratégicos e promovendo articulação institucional.
  • Analisar e propor ajustes regulatórios aplicáveis aos produtos de comercialização, com foco em competitividade, inovação e conformidade.
  • Interpretar normativos regulatórios aplicáveis a projetos de geração, incluindo temas de conexão e transmissão, para orientar áreas técnicas e jurídicas.
  • Contribuir com o planejamento estratégico regulatório do grupo, propondo ações e metas alinhadas à agenda institucional.
  • Apoiar áreas internas com pareceres regulatórios especializados, assegurando segurança jurídica e técnica nas decisões corporativas.
  • Desenvolver materiais executivos para alta liderança, traduzindo temas regulatórios complexos em linguagem acessível e estratégica.
  • Fortalecer o relacionamento com stakeholders estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e institucional em temas regulatórios.

Informações Adicionais / O que esperamos de você:

  • Capacidade Técnica: Conhecimento da estrutura regulatória do setor elétrico e suas alterações, com foco nas regras de comercialização de energia no Brasil.
  • Análise Crítica: Habilidade para identificar riscos e oportunidades de negócios a partir das mudanças regulatórias, propondo e negociando melhorias na regulação do setor elétrico e nas regras de comercialização de energia.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Competência para acompanhar publicações relevantes no DOU e pautas regulatórias nas Reuniões da Diretoria da ANEEL, além de representar os negócios não regulados do Grupo CPFL junto às autoridades competentes e associações de agentes de mercado.
  • Colaboração e Influência: Capacidade de suportar a construção de contribuições às consultas públicas, tomadas de subsídios e demais atos regulatórios relacionados ao Setor Elétrico, interagindo com a Diretoria Executiva do grupo CPFL e áreas internas clientes.
  • Proatividade e Inovação: Elaboração de estudos e pareceres regulatórios para diversas áreas dos negócios não regulados, clientes, fornecedores e públicos diversos, sempre buscando maximizar o resultado consolidado do Grupo CPFL.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Wellhub;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

title: Manager of Instructional Teams
description:
About Us

Fullstack Academy is America's preeminent tech-training bootcamp. From coding to Ai, and cyber security to data analytics, we offer comprehensive and immersive online programs that have helped thousands of professionals launch their careers in the most vibrant sectors of today's economy.

"Fullstack Academy has been a life-changing experience" is something we hear often and the reason why we come to work everyday. We’re looking for a part-time Instructor to help transform the lives of our students, and through them, their communities and economies.

Role

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Manager of Instructional Teams, reporting to the Director of Student Experience and Success, is responsible for overseeing the learner experience while supporting the instructional staff in delivering high-quality instruction. The role supports student progress and drives retention by monitoring cohort health metrics, managing transfers and dismissals, and ensuring compliance with company policies and regulations. The Manager of Instructional Teams provides ongoing coaching and evaluation for instructors, supervises Learner Experience Managers and the Manager of Curriculum, and partners with HR and recruiting on faculty hiring, onboarding, and staffing. By managing instructional resources, maintaining SOPs, and supporting curriculum updates, the Manager of Instructional Teams ensures academic operations run efficiently and consistently. This leadership role plays a critical part in strengthening teaching effectiveness, supporting instructional staff, and enhancing the overall student experience.

This role is full-time and remote. Please note: the ability to flex hours is critical in supporting instructional team members and will be an expectation of the person in this role.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure an exceptional student experience by supporting student progress, accessibility, and overall success
  • Oversee student experience by monitoring progress and retention, implementing strategies for improvement
  • Manage student transfers, withdrawals, and dismissals in accordance with company policies
  • Serve as a point of escalation for student concerns and resolutions
  • Develop student accommodation plans, ensuring alignment of practices with ADA requirements
  • Monitor cohort health metrics, analyzing both qualitative and quantitative feedback to measure overall student experience
  • Design and implement strategies to improve NPS, retention, and instructional quality
  • Lead and support instructional staff to strengthen teaching effectiveness, ensure compliance, and maintain high instructional quality
  • Evaluate instructors on a regular cadence, providing coaching and feedback for continuous improvement
  • Collaborate with recruiting and human resources on hiring, onboarding, and management of instructional team members
  • Oversee cohort staffing and coverage, ensuring compliance with regulations, including adequate substitute support
  • Supervise a team of Learner Experience Managers, supporting their day-to-day operations
  • Oversee program alignment, instructional delivery, and operational effectiveness to ensure consistency and quality across all cohorts
  • Liaise between Finance and Learner Experience teams to improve retention outcomes
  • Collaborate with the curriculum team to update courses with new iterations based on learner and staff feedback
  • Supervise the Manager of Curriculum, aligning tasks with student needs
  • Collaborate with Enrollment and Career Success teams to ensure seamless student transitions
  • Manage instructional costs by monitoring resource and staffing allocations
  • Update and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for instructional teams and develop additional SOPs when needed

Qualifications

You're a great candidate if you have:

  • 1 year of experience in a technical field- web development, data analytics, cybersecurity, or teaching technology
  • Proficient in using learning management systems, electronic resources, and emerging academic technologies
  • 2+ years of experience in education, teaching, instructional coaching, academic operations, or learning and development, specifically supporting instructors or trainers to drive learner success, managing projects, and hiring new team members
  • Bachelor's degree required. Master's Degree preferred
  • Experience with onboarding and building effective teams
  • Thrive in an ever-changing environment and can effectively lead a team through changes
  • Experience working remotely and teaching or training in an online environment
  • Strong sense of ownership and a "whatever-it-takes" attitude
  • A strong growth mindset
  • Project management and organizational skills
  • Communication skills (verbal and written), presentation skills, and computer skills
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of information

Compensation

The expected compensation for this role is $80,000 to $85,000 OTE plus benefits. Final offer amounts will be determined based on a candidate’s individual experience, skills, and qualifications.

title: Enterprise Risk Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Centerstone is among the nation’s leading nonprofit behavioral health systems with thousands of employees dedicated to delivering care that changes people’s lives. A dynamic, well-established organization, we offer rewarding opportunities to serve all ages in a variety of settings. Come talk to us about joining the Centerstone team!

SUMMARY OF POSITION

The Enterprise Risk Manager is responsible for ongoing risk assessment and mitigation as documented in the Risk Management Plan. Develops and maintains systems within the organization to detect, monitor, prevent, organize, measure, investigate, report, and manage patient adverse events, malpractice claims, incident reports, and other indicators of potential patient harm. The organization’s key aims in this area are to be a high reliability organization that integrate a Just Culture framework toward a culture of patient safety.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinates the risk management program for the organization and facilitates patient safety activities within the Centerstone Patient Safety Organization.
  • Performs investigation of potentially reportable incident(s) to local regulatory agencies
  • Interfaces with the on-site investigators reporting potential claims as well as cases of concern by preparation of preliminary reports, and determination of priority of investigation given risk management assessment.
  • Conducts risk assessments, collecting and analyzing documentation, statistics, reports, and market trends.
  • Communicates high risk and/or high-profile events with Centerstone legal representatives and/or external insurance carriers
  • Recommends policies and procedures to identify and address risks in the organizations services and departments.
  • Investigate and analyze actual and potential risks within the organization; assess liability and probability of legal action for potential notification.
  • Review incident/safety concerns with the leadership team to identify systemic issues and facilitate the development of corrective actions. Recommends and implements risk management solutions such as insurance, safety and security policies, business continuity plans, environment of care, or recovery measures.
  • Coordinates with necessary health and safety leaders throughout the organization to ensure an environment of care that is safe for clients and a workplace that is safe for staff and stakeholders
  • Works collaboratively with management and leadership to conduct a comprehensive risk assessment on an annual basis
  • Recommends a risk management plan for the health system on an annual basis
  • Provides data to leadership necessary to inform risk mitigation strategies for the organization

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Proven management ability and experience including a thorough understanding of quality improvement (QI) processes, tools, and techniques; quality measurement and reporting; root cause analysis and preventive risk management strategies; accrediting bodies’ standards; and state and federal regulations.
  • Knowledge of risk information management systems (RIMS).
  • Ability to effectively interact and lead risk management activities across multi-state locations and business units

QUALIFICATIONS

Education Level

Minimum of Bachelor’s Degree in healthcare related field required

Years of Experience

Minimum of three (3) years of risk related experience in a behavioral healthcare setting required

Certification/Licensure

Currently a certified professional healthcare risk manager (CPHRM), or eligible to obtain within 6 months of hire

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Standing – 20%

Sitting – 80%

Squatting – Occasional

Kneeling – Occasional

Bending – Occasional

Driving – Occasional

Lifting – Occasional

DISCLAIMER

The duties and responsibilities described in this document are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time, or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.

Time Type: Full time

Pay Range: $67,610.00--$101,430.00

Delivering care that changes people's lives starts with our employees. Below are just some of the great benefits Centerstone employees enjoy:

  • Medical, dental, and vision health coverage
  • Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts
  • 403b retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off and ten paid holidays
  • AD&D Insurance, Life Insurance, and Long Term Disability (company paid)
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Continuing education opportunities
  • Employee Assistance Program

Centerstone is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at Centerstone is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. We treat all clients and colleagues with dignity and respect.

At Centerstone, we use our values as a guide for what we do. Respect, Expertise, Integrity and Empowerment are at the heart of every interaction at Centerstone, and particularly rooted in our Culture.

Our approach to culture is to create an environment that encourages, supports and celebrates the voices and experiences of our employees. We are committed to a culture of empowerment, respect, integrity and expertise that powers our innovation and connects us to each other, our clients and the communities we serve.

Centerstone is also committed to a strong culture of quality and safety, celebrating role-models who champion best practices for quality, clinical risk, and patient safety.

title: Paid Search Manager
description:
Overview

About Skillshare

Skillshare is the leading learning community for creatives. With more than 30,000 expert-led classes in illustration, design, photography, video, marketing, and more, Skillshare empowers anyone, anywhere to learn new skills, share expertise, and unlock their creative potential.

Hundreds of thousands of member subscribers around the world come to Skillshare to discover new passions, advance careers, and connect with an inspiring community of teachers and peers.

Backed by top investors including Newspring Capital, OMERS Ventures, and Union Square Ventures, our mission is to build the world’s most thriving creative learning community.

The Role

We’re looking for a data-driven and strategic Paid Search Manager to own and optimize our campaigns across the Google Ads portfolio. Reporting to the Performance Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for driving profitable growth and maximizing subscription volume at an efficient CAC. This role sits at the core of our growth engine, requiring a deep understanding of campaign management, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration to drive subscriptions and improve conversion rates across the funnel. You will be responsible for strategy, execution, and reporting, making data-driven decisions to scale our paid search efforts effectively.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize campaigns across the full Google Ads portfolio, including Search, PMax, YouTube, Video Action, and others.
  • Lead keyword strategy and bidding across both branded and non-branded queries to maximize subscription volume at an efficient CAC.
  • Run a disciplined test-and-learn program across bidding, targeting, and funnel variations, and partner with internal data teams to evolve dashboards that surface actionable insights.
  • Drive Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) initiatives within your channels by working cross-functionally with engineering and design to develop, implement, and maintain a testing roadmap.
  • Monitor campaign performance, generate actionable insights from data, and communicate data-driven decisions to key stakeholders.
  • Stay current on Google Ads and performance marketing trends, platform changes, privacy regulations, attribution strategies, and AI-powered search features to maximize performance.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: You have 3+ years of hands-on experience managing SEM and running PPC campaigns in Google Ads, ideally in a fast-paced environment like a subscription business or an agency.
  • Data-driven mindset: You have fluency in campaign data analysis and optimization, with proficiency in Google Sheets, cohort analysis, and ROAS modeling. You have a proven ability to translate numbers into actions.
  • Platform Expertise: You have a strong understanding of search and Google-owned ad placements, including Search, PMax, YouTube, App Campaigns, and Demand Gen.
  • Cross-functional collaborator: You have the ability to work effectively with product, web, creative, and analytics teams to optimize acquisition performance from end to end.
  • Excellent communicator: You can translate complex insights into clear decisions and communicate effectively to stakeholders within and outside of the marketing team.
  • Strategic owner: You are comfortable owning strategy, execution, and reporting, and are curious, commercially aware, and comfortable making quick decisions.
  • Mission alignment: You’re excited by Skillshare’s vision of building the world’s most thriving creative learning community.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with other performance marketing channels such as Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit and others.
  • Experience with international markets outside of the US or managing global accounts.
  • Experience within startup or scale-up environments.
  • Experience working with ed-tech or subscription based companies.

At Skillshare, we believe creativity thrives in an inclusive environment. We’re excited to meet candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. If you’re passionate about what we do but don’t check every single box, we’d still love to hear from you — curiosity and growth matter most to us.

Docusign brings agreements to life. Overview

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the top 5 consumer goods companies in the world. With over 500 beer brands, we are the number one or two in many of the main beer markets worldwide, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group enables us to maximize the use of data and drive AB InBev's digital transformation and organic growth around the world.

What you'll do

We are looking for a talented and passionate Data Engineer to join our growing team. You will use various cutting-edge technologies to develop and maintain data pipelines. To succeed in the Data Engineering position, you should have strong self-learning and analytical skills and the ability to utilize different Big Data technologies to design and develop different data pipelines, as well as some exposure to project and team management experiences. If you are detail-oriented and motivated, with excellent organizational skills, we’d like to hear from you.

Core Responsibilities

  • Support the Data Engineering team lead to ensure the quality and agility of the team activities
  • Work collaboratively and creatively with other data engineers to develop scalable and maintainable data pipelines using the latest technologies and leading industry practices
  • Build data pipelines that ingest various data sources into the Harmonized Data Mesh structure and make it available for consumption for both internal data analytics and data science teams, as well as external clients
  • Debug, unit-test, and deploy data pipelines, and optimize
  • Ingest and manage metadata in relation to data and processes
  • Manage, document, and version code
  • Participate and promote the Data Engineering best practices across the organization
  • Participate and promote Enterprise Data Governance frameworks
  • Partner with a variety of internal stakeholders across the organization to deliver creative, cutting-edge, high-quality engineering solutions that meet business requirements in a fast-paced, ever-changing business environment
  • Be part of a cross-functional team, directly contributing to feature development and maintenance of a global product
  • Partner with colleagues to build and maintain tooling for test development, automation, and release processes improvement
  • Advocate for the user experience when communicating with product, design, and tech
  • Follow best development practices to achieve continuous improvement
  • Provide the team with a quality strategy that supports the team\'s delivery goals
  • Be constantly challenged to create world-class solutions.

What you'll need

  • Experience in Data Engineering
  • Experience with cloud computing, preferably Azure
  • Strong understanding in the modern data storage and evolution (Data Lake, Delta Lake, Lakehouse etc.)
  • Experience working with Big Data frameworks, preferably Databricks etc.
  • Experience working with transactional/relational data and SQL
  • Strong experience in performance tuning and optimizations in PySpark and SQL
  • Strong experience working on Agile teams implementing DevOps practices
  • Strong experience in CI/CD pipelines
  • Excellent communication skills, adapting to various audience types
  • Passionate about innovation and loves solving complex problems in a highly- collaborative, fast-paced team environment

More about you

  • You're passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You're motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You're creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

title: TRADER
description:
Job description

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Main responsibilities

  • Atuar na comercialização internacional de carne bovina, gerindo negociações com clientes em mercados estratégicos.
  • Monitorar diariamente os mercados globais, câmbio, fretes e tendências de consumo, propondo estratégias comerciais alinhadas ao posicionamento da Minerva.
  • Definir preços de venda, volumes e prazos, buscando maximizar margens e competitividade.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo e estratégico com clientes, parceiros comerciais e stakeholders internos.
  • Coordenar fluxo entre áreas internas (logística, financeiro, operações, qualidade e documentação) garantindo execução eficiente dos contratos.
  • Realizar análises de risco e oportunidades de mercado, utilizando ferramentas de hedge, contratos futuros e opções quando aplicável.
  • Apoiar o time na elaboração de relatórios de mercado, previsões de demanda e inteligência comercial para suportar decisões estratégicas.

Requirements and skills

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Comércio Exterior, Agronegócios ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Comércio Internacional, Gestão de Riscos ou Agronegócio será considerado diferencial.

Experiência Profissional:

  • Experiência consolidada em trading de proteínas animais , com ênfase em carne bovina (obrigatório).
  • Vivência em negociação internacional de outras commodities agropecuárias (soja, milho, farelos, DDGS ou grãos em geral).
  • Experiência prévia em frigoríficos ou empresas do setor de proteína animal, com entendimento de processos produtivos, rendimento industrial e especificações de cortes para exportação.
  • Histórico de gestão de contratos de exportação, definição de preços e acompanhamento de execução logística internacional.

Conhecimentos Técnicos e Ferramentas:

  • Forte domínio de precificação de cortes bovinos e subprodutos , considerando custos, margens e particularidades de cada mercado.
  • Conhecimento de formação de preços em grãos e insumos relacionados à cadeia de proteína animal.
  • Capacidade de análise de mercado (oferta, demanda, câmbio, fretes, relatórios setoriais – USDA, Urner Barry, Gira etc.).
  • Familiaridade com derivativos agrícolas (futuros e opções) como ferramenta de gestão de risco – desejável, mas não essencial.
  • Experiência em logística internacional de carnes e grãos , incluindo incoterms, custos de frete e barreiras regulatórias (MAPA, USDA, AQSIQ, SFDA, entre outros).
  • Excel avançado e ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Experiência com ERP (SAP será diferencial).

Idiomas:

  • Inglês avançado/fluente (essencial para negociação internacional).
  • Espanhol altamente desejável; Mandarim é diferencial competitivo.

Habilidades Interpessoais e Comportamentais:

  • Forte capacidade de negociação global e relacionamento de longo prazo com clientes e fornecedores.
  • Perfil analítico, com leitura de mercado e habilidade em tomada de decisão sob cenários voláteis.
  • Proatividade, resiliência e visão estratégica voltada para resultados.
  • Habilidade de atuar em ambientes multiculturais e de alta pressão.

Certificações e Cursos Desejáveis:

  • Cursos em Trading e Mercados de Commodities (B3, CME, FIA, ou instituições especializadas).
  • Certificações em Comércio Exterior (ComexGestão, ICC, FIATA).
  • Capacitações em Mercados Agropecuários e Proteína Animal .

Additional information

  • Vale Alimentação.
  • Vale Refeição.
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica.
  • Wellhub.
  • Seguro de Vida.

Responsibilities

  • Managing Google Ads Campaigns: Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Search, Display, and Video.
  • Bottom-of-Funnel Focus: Prioritize conversions that go beyond lead generation, including SQLs, pipeline impact, and closed-won revenue.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams: Partner closely with sales to align on lead quality, refine campaign targeting, and maintain a strong feedback loop.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Create dashboards and evaluate campaign results using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and spreadsheets.
  • Full-Funnel & Lead Quality Insights: Deep knowledge of the buyer journey and how paid media influences progression through the funnel.
  • A/B Testing & Creative Iteration: Conduct A/B tests on targeting, ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding tactics to drive performance gains.
  • Cross-Channel Integration: Collaborate with the broader marketing team to maintain cohesive messaging and strategic alignment across all channels.
  • Landing Page & CRO Collaboration: Coordinate with design teams to enhance landing page effectiveness and improve conversion rates.
  • Budget Management & Forecasting: Manage spend pacing and performance targets, with clear reporting on ROI and CAC.
  • Platform Expansion: Research and experiment with emerging ad formats and placements within the Google Ads platform.

Experience we\'re looking for

  • Expertise in Google Ads: Over 5 years of hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across Google Search, Display, and Video.

  • Strong Analytical Abilities: Proficiency in using Google Analytics, spreadsheets, Looker Studio (or similar tools), and analyzing campaign performance data.
  • Collaboration with Sales: Proven experience partnering with sales teams to enhance campaign impact on the sales pipeline.
  • Advanced Conversion Tracking: Knowledgeable in UTM parameters, pixel setup, and using Google Tag Manager for tracking.
  • Proficient in English: Effective in communicating and collaborating in English across teams and documentation.
  • CRM Awareness: Understanding of how paid media campaigns connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

What we’re looking for this role to achieve

  • Drive higher revenue attributed to marketing through Google Ads campaigns.
  • Enhance SQL rates and boost lead-to-deal conversions via paid media channels.
  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.
  • Lower cost per acquisition (CPA) while improving return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Expand a full-funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. At Innodata, we're working with the world's largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We're looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Chemistry Subject Matter Expert (SME) to contribute to the development and training of AI Large Language Models (LLMs).   • Master's or PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related scientific field.

  • Prior experience in academic research, technical writing, or teaching is highly desirable.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world\'s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we\'re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master\'s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.
  • *The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*
