description:
Overview

  • Department: Infrastructure
  • Schedule: Full-time, 8 hour day shift, Monday - Friday
  • Location: Remote
  • Salary: $118,129.00 - $159,821.00 per year
  • Eligible for an annual bonus incentive

What You Will Do

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Manager of Collaboration to lead our team and oversee our collaboration tools and technologies. This role is not just about maintaining our existing systems; it's about defining what "best-in-class" collaboration looks like for our organization and driving us toward that vision. You will lead our internal team of collaboration engineers and oversee our third-party support provider. Your role is to manage this vendor relationship, ensuring they meet our high standards for service delivery and user satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Strategy and Leadership: Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for our collaboration technology stack, aligning with business goals and future growth. Lead, mentor, and manage a team of internal collaboration engineers and specialists. Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in the collaboration space, evaluating and recommending new solutions.
  • Defining and Delivering Best-in-Class Collaboration: Act as the primary champion for a "best-in-class" collaboration strategy, focusing on user experience, security, and productivity. Develop and implement governance policies and a "right tool for the job" framework to guide employees on when to use email, instant messaging, or video conferencing. Proactively identify and implement features within our existing tools (Google Workspace, Zoom, MS Exchange) to maximize their value and enhance team efficiency. Foster a culture of effective communication and collaboration, working with stakeholders to optimize workflows and reduce communication overload.
  • Vendor and Service Delivery Management: Serve as the primary point of contact and accountability for our outsourced support provider. Define, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) to ensure the vendor meets performance targets. Conduct regular business reviews with the vendor to assess performance, identify areas for improvement, and ensure alignment with our strategic goals. Act as the escalation point for major issues and work closely with the vendor to ensure timely and effective resolution.
  • Security & Governance: Partner with our internal security team to manage and enforce security policies across all collaboration platforms. Oversee email security, data governance, and user access controls to protect sensitive information.
  • Platform Management: Administer and manage our Google Workspace environment, including Gmail, Calendar, Drive, and Meet. Oversee the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of our Zoom platform for meetings, webinars, and room systems. Manage and support our on-premises Microsoft Exchange servers, ensuring high availability and seamless integration with other systems. Maintain and support our conference room technologies, including Logitech kits, Chromeboxes, and Q-Sys audio/video solutions.
  • User Experience and Training: Develop and deliver training programs and documentation to empower users to effectively use collaboration tools. Gather user feedback to identify areas for improvement and work with the outsourced provider to address gaps and drive a better user experience.
  • Project Management: Lead collaboration-related projects, from initial planning and requirements gathering to implementation and post-deployment support. Manage budgets and resources for the collaboration team and related projects.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Strong knowledge of Google Workspace administration and management.
  • 5+ years of experience in managing collaboration technologies in an enterprise environment.
  • Proven experience in vendor management , including negotiating contracts and managing service delivery.
  • Strong knowledge of Zoom administration, including Zoom Rooms and API integrations.
  • Experience with Microsoft Exchange Server administration and hybrid environments.
  • Solid understanding of conference room technologies, including A/V systems, video conferencing hardware (Logitech, Chromeboxes ), and audio processing platforms (Q-Sys).
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Google Workspace Administrator, Zoom Certified Professional) are a plus.

What You Will Need

Education:

  • High School diploma equivalency with 3 years of cumulative experience OR Associate'sdegree/Bachelor's degree with 2 years of cumulative experience OR 7 years of applicable cumulative job specific experience required.
  • 3 years of leadership or management experience preferred.

Additional Preferences

No additional preferences.

title: DESENVOLVEDOR FULLSTACK
description:
Com o propósito de levar emoção à vida das pessoas, a La Moda busca profissionais que têm metas arrojadas e sonham alto, que são obcecados pelos detalhes em busca da perfeição, que admiram a inteligência de quem quer aprender sempre, que envolvem as pessoas para criar coesão e que todos os dias fazem o trivial de um jeito diferente, surpreendendo, pois têm a ousadia de ir além.

Todas as nossas vagas também são dedicadas para pessoas com deficiência.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Desenvolver e manter aplicações Full Stack utilizando Node.js no backend e frameworks modernos no frontend (React, Next.js ou similares).
  2. Criar e otimizar APIs REST e GraphQL para integração entre plataformas (ERP, OMS, CRM, VTEX, etc.).
  3. Implementar e customizar soluções na plataforma VTEX , atendendo demandas de múltiplas marcas e canais de venda.
  4. Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários, integração e end-to-end).
  5. Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de produto, UX/UI e negócios para traduzir requisitos em soluções técnicas eficientes.
  6. Manter e evoluir integrações com sistemas B2B, gateways de pagamento, logística e marketplaces.
  7. Monitorar performance e disponibilidade das soluções, realizando ajustes para escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade.
  8. Aplicar boas práticas de segurança e compliance no desenvolvimento e nas integrações.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com Node.js e frameworks de backend (NestJS, Express ou similares).
  • Experiência com integrações B2B (ERP, OMS, WMS, CRM) e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Vivência em operações multimarcas e gestão de múltiplos catálogos e regras comerciais.
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB).
  • Experiência com versionamento Git e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

O Grupo La Moda é um organismo pulsante, inventor de marcas que já nascem com alto desejo e sucesso de números. Desenvolve soluções inovadoras capazes de conectar as vontades das pessoas com as tendências de moda e comportamento.

Nossa história começou em 1986, com um pequeno negócio familiar, fundada pelo casal Arcílio e Vera Olivo. Após 20 anos de experiência na área de confecção com moda infantil, nasce em 2006, a Lança Perfume . O crescimento exponencial obtido pela marca e sua relevância no mercado elevou o Grupo La Moda a outro patamar, possibilitando a construção de novas marcas para atender diferentes públicos, em 2016 a My Favorite e em 2021 a Lança Perfume Easy .

O Grupo La Moda tem como propósito levar emoção à vida das pessoas e conta, atualmente, com cerca de 1000 colaboradores. O Grupo possui a matriz instalada em Criciúma/SC, unidades nas cidades de Nova Veneza/SC, dois Showrooms de vendas direta, nas cidades de São Paulo/SP e Goiânia/GO, além de 20 lojas próprias a nível nacional.

Nossos valores são nossos princípios inegociáveis. Uma escolha genuína. Acreditamos que podemos fazer o trivial de um jeito totalmente diferente e extraordinário. Nossos valores norteiam nossas ações e, baseado neles, tomamos nossas decisões. São eles: Aprender e Ensinar; Sonhar Alto; Inconformismo; Colaboração; Surpreender.

  • Responsável pela captação e suporte aos planos estratégicos de vendas da CPFL Serviços;

  • Gerar insights a partir de informações de pesquisa de mercado;
  • Desenvolver relatórios, analisar e propor iniciativas de B2B (Business to Business), conectando a estratégia da categoria com estudos de mercado e demais ferramentas com dados sobre o negócio;

Conheça um pouco sobre nós

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

Trusting Social is an AI fintech dedicated to advancing data science and technology to promote financial inclusion for all. We provide AI-powered credit risk, identity, and acquisition solutions for emerging markets, partnering with banks to expand credit access to underbanked consumers. Since 2013, we've become the leading credit risk assessment platform in Southeast Asia, with over 1 billion scored customers and $800 million in loans disbursed.

We collaborate with 130+ financial institutions across Vietnam, Philippines, India, and Indonesia and have raised $100 million in Series C funding to scale our new credit cards business. Our mission is to enable credit lines for 10M+ people in the Philippines, India, and Indonesia, and we're seeking passionate, entrepreneurial, and data-driven individuals to join our diverse team.

Headquartered in Singapore with offices in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Manila, Jakarta, Bangalore and Mumbai, we're guided by values like extreme ownership, data-driven decision-making, mindfulness, and social impact. We aim to make universal financial inclusion a reality in Southeast Asia and India within the next decade, and your expertise can help us achieve this goal.

At Kompato AI, we’re reimagining the consumer credit ecosystem, and our System Administrator role is critical to making it happen. We’re hiring top talent from India (Bangalore), Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh), the Philippines (Manila), and Latin America (Brazil, Argentina, Colombia) to join our global team working US Eastern hours.

You’ll ensure the reliability and performance of platforms like Interprose, Looker, and Collin, support seamless client onboarding and integrations, and act as the first line of defense for technical issues. Your efforts will directly bridge product development and daily operations, translating our innovative AI technology into tangible business success.

By collaborating across vendors, clients, and internal teams, you’ll not only keep systems running at peak performance but also help shape their future—driving uptime, efficiency, and client satisfaction on a global scale.

What You’ll Do

System Configuration & Operations

  • Configure Interprose for live operations during US time zone.

Support & Escalation

  • Share feedback and requirements for new features and bug fixes.

Required Skills

  • Hands-on experience with CRM/collection platforms (Interprose preferred).

  • Clear documentation and communication abilities.
  • Ability to work US timezone hours.
  • Experience with file transfer protocols and data exchange formats.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2+ years in system administration, operations, or technical support.
  • Familiarity with Looker or other BI tools.
  • Knowledge of compliance requirements (FDCPA, TCPA).
  • Experience with API integrations and data mapping.
  • Background in debt collection or financial services a plus.

Why Join Us?

  • Enjoy competitive salary and comprehensive benefits that support your well-being.
  • Global mission: Work on a problem that truly matters.
  • Learn fast: Collaborate with brilliant teammates across product, sales, and operations.
  • Impact: Your contributions will directly improve client experience and operational excellence.

At Trusting Social, we live by ownership, integrity, and agility in execution. We believe in doing what's right, what's best, and what's innovative. If you're smart, driven, and want to make a difference in the world with the most advanced and fascinating technology, we invite you to be part of our rockstar team!

title: Onboarding Specialist, Migration
description:
Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

At Boulevard, our Customer Experience team is dedicated to launching, supporting, and strengthening relationships with our clients. As an Onboarding Specialist , Data Migrations , you will play a pivotal role in helping customers transition from legacy systems to the Boulevard platform with minimal disruption and maximum confidence.

You'll be the technical partner behind the scenes—transforming, cleaning, and validating data to ensure accuracy, security, and a seamless migration experience. From pre-sale planning through post-launch cleanup, you'll own end-to-end data migration workflows while collaborating cross-functionally to ensure every customer launch is a success.

What you'll do here:

Pre-Sale & Scoping

  • Meet with prospective clients pre-close to understand their data needs and align migration expectations.
  • Partner with Sales to scope technical requirements and validate feasibility.
  • Participate in customer and prospect calls as a subject matter expert on data migrations.

Data Migration & Import

  • Own and manage full-service and free import migrations from initial planning through final execution.
  • Perform imports using tools such as Flatfile and Google Sheets with high accuracy and consistency.
  • Execute structured QA and validation checks on all data prior to launch.
  • Handle migration-related CFDs/CSRs and execute bulk updates (e.g., pricing changes, contact edits).
  • Clean up migrations on launch day in partnership with Onboarding Specialists, focusing on data integrity.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Coordinate full-service migrations with teams like Odetta and Customer Operations (COPS).
  • Work closely with Engineering to manage escalations, track bugs, and improve tooling.
  • Partner with COPS and Engineering on Flatfile improvements and onboarding tools.
  • Support Onboarding Specialists in resolving real-time data issues during customer launches.

Operational & Team Support

  • Track migration timelines, coordinate launch calendars, and communicate progress and blockers clearly.
  • Answer internal team questions in shared Slack channels (#onboarding-questions, etc.).
  • Assist in data review for proof-of-concept migrations for strategic accounts.
  • Create and maintain internal documentation and one-sheets related to migrations and tooling.

What you'll need to thrive:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing data migrations or working with platform dashboards.
  • 1+ year of direct experience with Boulevard dashboard and data migrations (preferred).
  • Advanced skills in Google Sheets or Excel -comfortable with formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and structured data manipulation.
  • Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving abilities under pressure.
  • Excellent project and time management—able to juggle multiple migrations simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong commitment to data accuracy and security.
  • Clear, confident communicator with the ability to collaborate across departments and work independently.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with Flatfile or similar structured import tools.
  • Experience with SaaS onboarding, technical support, or customer implementation.
  • Knowledge of data privacy best practices, especially around marketing consent and HIPAA customer data handling.

How we'll take care of you:

Your starting budgeted cash compensation for this role is between $64,000 - $92,000, depending on your current skills, experience, training, and overall market demands. This total compensation range is subject to change, and there is always room for growth and advancement.

In addition to the wonderful people you'll get to work with and challenging projects that'll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you're always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically.

  • We've got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance.
  • Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy.
  • Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You'll receive a work from home stipend every month.
  • Family planning resources and specialized support programs.
  • Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard.
  • Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve.

We recommend following our official LinkedIn page to stay up to date on all things Boulevard life!

  • Strong knowledge of BSA, AML, KYC , and financial regulations.

  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Regular

title: Legal Operations & Contracts Manager
description:
At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy.

Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower fearless commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here!

Department

The Legal team at Signifyd plays a critical role in enabling and protecting the business as it scales. Our team is responsible for drafting and negotiating contracts, reviewing privacy and data protection matters, supporting product development, and overseeing corporate governance. We work closely with the Sales, Partnerships, Product, Revenue Operations (RevOps), and Finance teams to help drive business objectives forward. By shaping processes that accelerate deal cycles, we help keep the commercial flywheel turning. At the same time, we ensure Signifyd’s risk exposure is carefully managed and our sensitive data is safeguarded through robust contractual protections.

Role

As a Legal Operations and Contracts Manager , you’ll help shape and optimize our legal systems and contracting processes while also drafting, reviewing, and negotiating agreements. You’ll collaborate with teams across the company to streamline deal cycles, improve our Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) tools, and support critical agreements such as NDAs, MSAs, and order forms.

We’re a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately. This is a hands-on role with significant opportunities for growth, perfect for someone who can balance business objectives with legal considerations, enjoys cross-functional collaboration, and thrives in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

  • Contract Negotiation: Review, draft and negotiate a variety of contracts, including nondisclosure agreements, master service agreements and statements of work.
  • Contract Lifecycle Management: Manage the entire contract lifecycle from intake and drafting to negotiation, execution, and renewal, including maintaining and managing our contract repository and electronic databases.
  • Sales and Stakeholder Advisory: Act as a primary point of contact for the sales team and other internal stakeholders, providing guidance and coordination throughout the contract lifecycle to ensure efficient and compliant deal execution.
  • Process Optimization: Develop, maintain, and enforce policies and standard operating procedures for legal and contracting processes. Continuously identify opportunities to accelerate contract closure by enhancing templates, streamlining negotiation workflows, and clarifying escalation guidelines.
  • System Administration: Act as the primary legal team interface with other departments in structuring cross-departmental functions, including the establishment and enhancement of company-wide IT systems, particularly our CLM tool.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Manage standard and ad-hoc reporting and metrics related to contract volume, turnaround times, and other key performance indicators to inform strategic decisions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the team to continually identify opportunities to accelerate contract closure, respond to inquiries effectively, and develop comprehensive contracting policies.
  • Innovation Champion: Be a champion for a better, faster, and simpler way of doing things within the legal and contracting functions.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in a legal operations or contract management role.
  • 4+ years proven experience drafting and reviewing commercial contracts, including MSAs, Order Forms, and NDAs.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the full contract lifecycle process and administration in a time-sensitive environment.
  • Experience managing legal technology, including CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management) tools, and managing integrations between systems. Familiarity with Ironclad, Zip, Salesforce, or similar platforms is a strong plus.
  • A self-starter who works with minimal supervision and high integrity, while also being a strong and collaborative team player.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate legal and business concepts to a variety of audiences.
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is helpful but is not required.
  • Bachelors degree preferred

This position can be based anywhere in the US, either fully remote or in one of our offices in San Jose, Seattle, Denver, or NYC.

Location & Benefits

Benefits in our US offices:

  • Discretionary Time Off Policy (Unlimited!)
  • 401K Match
  • Stock Options
  • Annual Performance Bonus or Commissions
  • Paid Parental Leave (12 weeks)
  • On-Demand Therapy for all employees & their dependents

description:
O time

O time de Engenharia de Dados da Incognia é responsável por melhorar e manter toda a infraestrutura de dados da empresa, desde clusters, serviços de dados e autenticação, até ETLs, notebooks e outras ferramentas necessárias que permitem que nossos colaboradores possam extrair métricas e inteligência de um vasto volume de dados ingeridos diariamente, de forma fácil, confiável, segura e respeitando a privacidade dos nossos usuários.

O trabalho do time é essencial para entregar uma variedade de soluções baseadas em um grande volume de dados coletados, no intuito de proteger usuários de diversos clientes de golpes e fraude.

A oportunidade

Precisamos de uma pessoa que tenha familiaridade com vários bancos de dados e engines de processamento distribuído, que consiga entender a fundo as ferramentas que usamos e que em caso necessário seja capaz de contribuir para os projetos opensource que rodamos em produção ou possa criar nossas próprias soluções para vencermos nossos desafios de dados.

Dia a dia da posição

  • Criar, implantar, manter e monitorar soluções de infraestrutura de dados para toda a empresa, incluindo deployments de ferramentas open source e soluções desenvolvidas internamente;
  • Prover ferramentas como software, guidelines e templates que tornem o uso da infraestrutura de dados fluida e de fácil acesso aos colaboradores;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de dados recorrentes e/ou em tempo real de alta performance para tratar grandes volumes de dados;
  • Monitorar constantemente nossos sistemas para garantir alta disponibilidade, performance e redução de custos;
  • Criar mecanismos que garantam as políticas de acesso aos dados;

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia de Software ou relacionado;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Experiência em kubernetes e deployment de sistemas em escala;
  • Experiência com ETLs/Pipelines em larga escala;
  • Experiência com o ecossistema Spark;
  • Experiência com Data Warehousing & Data Lake;
  • Familiaridade com vários bancos de dados;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas distribuídos;

Sobre a Incognia

A Incognia é a empresa inovadora em soluções de identidade de última geração que possibilitam experiências digitais seguras e sem fricção. Com sua solução persistente de identificação de dispositivos, a Incognia combina sinais de reconhecimento de dispositivo de excelência e à prova de adulteração e análise de localização para verificação de usuários e prevenção de fraudes. As avaliações de risco personalizáveis e insights acionáveis da Incognia permitem que empresas de serviços financeiros, plataformas de delivery e da economia compartilhada e marketplaces protejam sua reputação, retenção de clientes e receita. Para mais informações, visite Incognia.com/pt

Sobre o time

Primeiramente, valorizamos muito a nossa cultura. Nossa equipe compartilha os valores de Ambição, Excelência e Confiança, seja em relação aos nossos usuários, clientes ou membros da equipe. Não toleramos desrespeito, discriminação, egoísmo, politicagem pessimismo, descrença e falta de responsabilidade. Respeitamos o direito de todos os membros da equipe de participar de expressões políticas e ativismos fora do ambiente de trabalho, mas para preservar a harmonia e o respeito mútuo em nosso ambiente de trabalho, debates políticos devem ser evitados em ambientes da Incognia. a Incognia também se abstém de fazer pronunciamentos institucionais sobre temas não diretamente relacionados com a sua atividade e Missão. Além disso, levamos muito a sério nosso desempenho. Por isso, oferecemos suporte através de nosso processo de onboarding, feedback frequentes com a liderança, ciclos de avaliação, feedback contínuo de colegas e as ferramentais certas para o seu desenvolvimento. Temos orgulho de ter uma equipe brilhante, humilde e colaborativa em um ambiente remoto.

Nossos valores

  • Nós não limitamos as nossas conquistas
  • Nós entregamos excelência através de consistência
  • Nós construímos confiança ao empoderar usuários, clientes e membros do time.

Remuneração e benefícios

  • Salário CLT entre R$ 20.386,27 a R$ 31.883,23
  • Confira nossos benefícios em nosso e-book: Incognia.com/pt

Etapas do processo

  • Entrevista com People
  • Entrevista com gestor
  • Entrevista técnica
  • Fit Cultural com CEO e CTO
  • Offer

A Incognia está comprometida em fornecer um ambiente de respeito mútuo onde oportunidades de emprego estejam disponíveis para todas as pessoas.
